title: 辛德拉·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 白发映衬紫色双眼，深色角冠轮廓鲜明，三颗紫球彼此分离。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Syndra is an adult mage with long white hair, violet eyes, a distinctive dark horned crown, and three separate floating purple spheres. A fully covering long-sleeved violet ceremonial dress, opaque leggings, gloves, and boots replace revealing costume areas while preserving her tall regal humanoid proportions and recognizable crown.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: violet, plum, lavender, silver white light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
